acceptance: RED first: on the real registry a strategy-options document lane's plan runs premise-challenge, forces-analysis, market-sizing and scope-baseline
A registry test fails when a phase named in goal_recipes[g] has an insert_when-only admission rule that cannot fire for goal_type g
fix: Make recipe and trigger one declaration: add the recipe goal types to each recipe phase's insert_when (or give those phases a rubric_hint), and pin the registry so a phase named in a goal recipe admits that goal type.
summary: goal_recipes.strategy-options (and business-plan, partnership-deal) name premise-challenge, forces-analysis, market-sizing and scope-baseline, but those phases' insert_when admit only other goal types (business-strategy, project-management, scout.cycle_size==large) and carry no rubric_hint, so insert-when-gates-plan skips all four on a strategy-options lane. Probed on the real registry 2026-10-01: all four clamped insert-when-gates-plan. Each skip now raises ORCHESTRATOR_PLAN_PHASE_GATED.
title: A strategy-options lane runs none of its goal recipe's phases: their insert_when never admits that goal type
